Watts printed the hymn under Job 5:6–8. The line that comes closest to it is marked.

6For distress does not spring from the dust, and trouble does not sprout from the ground. 7Yet man is born to trouble as surely as sparks fly upward. 8However, if I were you, I would appeal to God and lay my cause before Him— JOB 5:6–8 · BEREAN STANDARD BIBLE READ JOB 5
Not from the dust affliction grows, Nor troubles rise by chance; Yet we are born to care and woes, A sad inheritance. STANZA I
